title: Frequently Asked Questions
body:
## Orders & Delivery

Q: How much does delivery cost?
The delivery charge for your order is worked out and shown at checkout, before you pay.
[Read our Shipping Policy](/policies/shipping/)

Q: Where can I see my orders?
Sign in to your account and open My Orders to see every order you have placed and where it stands.
[Go to My Orders](/account/orders/)

Q: Can I cancel my order?
Get in touch as soon as you can and we will help if the order has not been sent yet.

## Returns

Q: Can I return or exchange a product?
Our return policy sets out what can be returned and how.
[Read our Return Policy](/policies/returns/)

## Payments & Products

Q: Which payment methods do you accept?
The payment methods available for your order are shown at checkout.

Q: Will the product look exactly like the photos?
We photograph every product carefully, but screens vary, so colours may look slightly different in person.

## Contact

Q: How can I reach you?
Our contact page has every way to reach us.
[Contact us](/contact/)

more.title: Still have a question?
more.lead: We are happy to help. Get in touch any time.
